title: Two-agent deadlock
summary: Detect two tasks blocked on each other.
test_prompts: Investigate TASK-AST-DEADLOCK-A and TASK-AST-DEADLOCK-B: check both directed blocking edges, current task states and assigned agents. Cite graph records for any confirmed cycle, identify what remains unknown, and propose human-reviewed escalation without modifying tasks or executing actions.
Which current graph records show why TASK-AST-DEADLOCK-A is blocked?
Does TASK-AST-DEADLOCK-B also depend on TASK-AST-DEADLOCK-A? Verify BOTH directed blocking relationships and cite both tasks.
Which agents are assigned to the blocked tasks? Distinguish confirmed assignment from candidate eligibility.
What human-reviewed escalation or dependency re-plan is appropriate? Recommend only; take no action.
